input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the volume of air served by scrubber-1-t6 in the Lab, as V = Qe * tau, from a raise phase at reduced speed and a decay phase at full speed, with the Lab's occupants as the CO2 source.

monitoring.reason: Lab occupants (source, exposed to raised CO2) plus CDR in Hab-B, who shares the air through the inter-module ventilation.

steps.why: Raise: reduced effective flow (about 0.3 m3/min) so the Lab CO2 climbs from 1600 ppm by several hundred ppm towards a higher equilibrium; about 0.25 tau if V is near the 30 m3 first guess at this flow.
Decay: full speed (Qe 1 m3/min); about one time constant (tau = 30 m3 / 1 m3/min = 30 min, first guess) recorded, fitted towards its equilibrium.

abort.source: scrubber.motor.state: CO2 of the Lab from co2-1-t6

abort.when: the device refuses a step's command
state of charge under the threshold
a monitored person leaves the 45-120 bpm band, monitoring is lost, or one more person enters the Lab

expected.rise: With 3 occupants at 0.38 L/min awake (1.14 L/min) and Qe about 0.3 m3/min at 30 percent, Lab CO2 rises from 1600 ppm by roughly 300 to 500 ppm over 25 min (about 2000 to 2100 ppm if V is about 30 m3), staying under 3000 ppm; equilibrium at 30 percent would be about G/Qe = 3800 ppm, never reached.
expected.decay: After the switch to 100 percent, CO2 falls towards C_eq about 1140 ppm (G/Qe = 1.14 L/min over 1 m3/min) with tau about V/Qe, about 30 min if V is about 30 m3, plus a scrubber lag of 3.33 min; fit C(t)=C_eq+(C0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau); V_lab = Qe * tau.
expected.result: V_lab expected of the order of 30 m3 (fitted range 10 to 200 m3); a fit far above the Lab's own volume (tau much longer than 30 min, Hab-B CO2 moving with the Lab's) would show the centralised ventilation couples Hab-B and the single-zone hypothesis fails; a change of occupants, or CO2 not rising in step 1, also invalidates the curve.

hypotheses: The Lab is one well-mixed zone; the hatch is held closed for the whole test and the exchange through the closed hatch and the inter-module ventilation (design flow 3 m3/min, hatch closed) is not measured and is not assumed zero: it may make the served volume larger than the Lab alone; Hab-B CO2 is recorded to show it.
Occupants (3 in the Lab) stay, awake, at steady activity (0.38 L/min each); the source is not measured.
Scrubber effective flow is linear with speed (1 m3/min at 100 percent, about 0.3 at 30 percent) with the 3.33 min lag; not verified by this test.
Sensor co2-1-t6 is accurate and its noise is small against a rise of several hundred ppm.
The first guess of V (30 m3) is only used to size the durations.
